bg.$description: Answer surface backing. It defaults to transparent so the enclosing surface shows through.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the answer's solid backing.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for the answer surface.

muted-bg.$description: Backing of quotes and table headings.

muted-bg-image.$description: Optional image over the muted backing.

muted-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for quotes and table headings.

muted-fg.$description: Ink for quotes and table headings, strengthened under more contrast.

inline-code-bg.$description: Solid backing of an inline code span.

inline-code-bg-image.$description: Optional image over the inline code backing.

inline-code-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for inline code.

inline-code-fg.$description: Ink for source within an inline code span.

quote-border.$description: Logical start rule of a quotation and the ink of a thematic divider.

block-gap.$description: Spacing between Markdown blocks at standard density.
